translationRepairs: The mothers of Princes Xiu of Hejian and Chuwén of Changle are missing from the record.
The mothers of Prince Xiu of Hejian and Chuwen of Changle are missing from the record.
Source has 河間王脩、長樂王處文二王; English "Princes Xiu" wrongly pluralizes a single personal name. Restore singular Prince Xiu and unaccented Chuwen.
Later Grand General Gao Zhao marched on Shu; Shizong made Ji General Who Pacifies the East to hold Xu and Yang.
Under Shizong he was made General Who Subdues the Barbarians and inspector of Qingzhou, then General Who Pacifies the North and inspector of Hengzhou, and entered as Minister of Revenue.
Idiomatic English for s0324 wrongly narrates Gao Zhao's Shu campaign (content of s0326). Restore offices 征虜將軍、青州刺史…度支尚書.
